process: president indirectly elected by the House of Representatives for a single 5-year term; following legislative elections, the president usually appoints the leader of the majority party or majority coalition as prime minister for a 5-year term; deputy prime minister appointed by the president on the advice of the prime minister
results: 2024: Myriam Spiteri DEBONO (PL) elected president; House of Representatives vote - unanimous; 2019: George VELLA (PL) elected president; House of Representatives vote - unanimous
cabinet: Cabinet appointed by the president on the advice of the prime minister
